explication: Hashtopolis is a multi-platform client-server system for distributing hashcat work across computers, with multi-user and group management. The main workflow is users organizing hash data and cracking work in the server, which assigns work to agents; agents report progress and results. The graph also includes the web interface, both documented API surfaces, permissions, and the persistence layer. Some connections reflect README-level product behavior; source excerpts and the index show additional internal relationships, but many runtime routes were not sampled.
